verdict.rationale: LiveKit's own docs show you can deploy agents to LiveKit Cloud that run without managing servers, keep them always-on, and have room recording start automatically when a room is created. These are autonomous, event-driven behaviors rather than a general automation system. There is no evidence of scheduled or recurring jobs, workflow triggers, or unattended background task orchestration beyond agents responding to sessions. Missing for 10: recurring schedule or cron-style automation, general trigger/workflow configuration for background tasks, independent or hands-on corroboration of autonomous background operation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
